_comment: ⭐ THE OPENING ARC (content-zone-design-guide.md §2.0) — the first quest in the game, and the one that hands the player their whole starting kit. Eliza offers and turns it in; the `gather` stage runs BOTH errands in parallel — talk to Hendrik + 3 stags, talk to Benjamin + 6 beets — and each talk is where one skill is taught: Wild from the father, Harvest from the uncle, then FirstAid from the mother on the turn-in. ⚑ PARALLEL MEANS UNORDERED: objectives in one stage are AND-ed with no order, so a player can kill stags before visiting Hendrik; the talk still has to happen. The beets are ordered anyway, by content: a Beet authors the Turnip's harvest lock, so no combat aura touches one until Harvest is learned. ⚑ NO TRACKER on `gather`, deliberately: a stage tracker replaces ALL derived lines with one and substitutes {n}/{m} from the first countable objective only, so it could show the stags or the beets but never both. Reward 150 XP = the L9 half-level rule at L1, the price village-welcome and turnip-chore pay. ⚑ TARGET LEVELS: authored for Stag spawns at level 1-2 near the homestead — the north-pasture herd is L14. Text deliberately plain (PO 2026-08-02).
title: Dinner for the Family
